g.title: G
No first vote. Meaning: This validator has not sent NotarVote or SkipVote for this slot. Purpose: The first decision is open. Block data, parent evidence, or a timeout can determine the next action.

Block waits for its parent. Meaning: The block is available, but the parent condition is false. The validator keeps the block without an initial vote. Purpose: A valid block must connect to a parent that this validator can support. ParentReady or a parent vote can permit another check.

V02: Parent condition false. When: A complete block arrives, but its parent does not meet the vote condition. Action: Keep the block for another check. Reason: The validator must not support a child before it has the required parent evidence.

a.xlink:title: The validator must not support a child before it has the required parent evidence.
V02: Parent condition false

g.title: Initial notar vote sent. Meaning: This validator supports the exact block B with its first vote. It has not sent a skip or fallback vote in this slot. Purpose: It can send FinalVote after it sees an ordinary notar certificate for B. A safe fallback event can instead cause recovery.

V03: Parent condition true. When: A complete valid block arrives. Its parent meets the condition. No first vote exists. Action: Send NotarVote for B. Reason: The block extends a chain that this validator can support under the protocol rules.

a.xlink:title: The block extends a chain that this validator can support under the protocol rules.
V03: Parent condition true

g.title: Initial skip vote sent. Meaning: This validator used its first vote to support progress past the slot. BadWindow is true for this slot. Purpose: It cannot replace that vote with an initial notar vote. A later SafeToNotar event can permit fallback support for a block.

V06: Skip this slot. When: A timeout or fallback handler calls trySkipWindow. This slot has no first vote. Action: Send SkipVote. Set Voted and BadWindow. Reason: This vote helps the network continue to another leader window. One validator’s skip vote does not prove that the leader failed.

a.xlink:title: This vote helps the network continue to another leader window. One validator's skip vote does not prove that the leader failed.
V06: Skip this slot

g.title: V05: Keep waiting. When: A new check still finds insufficient parent evidence. Action: Keep the block and wait. Reason: A new event alone does not make the block safe to support.

a.xlink:title: A new event alone does not make the block safe to support.
V05: Keep waiting

g.title: V04: Parent condition true. When: ParentReady or a parent vote permits a new check. The stored block now meets the condition. Action: Send NotarVote for B. Remove the pending entry. Reason: The missing parent evidence is now available. The block does not need to arrive again.

a.xlink:title: The missing parent evidence is now available. The block does not need to arrive again.
V04: Parent condition true

g.title: V07: Skip the pending slot. When: The window skip function reaches this pending slot. The slot has no first vote. Action: Send SkipVote. Remove the pending entry. Reason: The validator must not later send a different first vote when the missing parent evidence arrives.

a.xlink:title: The validator must not later send a different first vote when the missing parent evidence arrives.
V07: Skip the pending slot

g.title: Fallback vote sent. Meaning: This validator sent an extra recovery vote after its first vote. Its first vote stays unchanged. Purpose: BadWindow prevents a later FinalVote in this slot. The validator can still accept a valid finality proof.

V09: Safe fallback condition. When: SafeToSkip becomes true, or SafeToNotar becomes true for a block other than the original B. Action: Run trySkipWindow. Send the permitted fallback vote. Set BadWindow for the target slot. Reason: The fallback condition excludes a conflicting fast-final result. The extra vote helps the network get a certificate and continue.

a.xlink:title: The fallback condition excludes a conflicting fast-final result. The extra vote helps the network get a certificate and continue.
V09: Safe fallback\ncondition

g.title: Final vote sent. Meaning: This validator sent FinalVote and set ItsOver. It must send no more new votes for this slot. Purpose: This commitment prevents its stake from also supporting a conflicting fallback result. One final vote does not finalize the block.

V08: Notar certificate for B. When: The validator has its own NotarVote for B and an ordinary notar certificate for B. BadWindow and ItsOver are false. Action: Send FinalVote for the slot. Set ItsOver. Reason: The certificate proves 60% initial support. The final vote commits this validator to stop fallback support in this slot.

a.xlink:title: The certificate proves 60% initial support. The final vote commits this validator to stop fallback support in this slot.
V08: Notar certificate for\nB

g.title: V10: SafeToNotar for a block. When: SafeToNotar becomes true for block C after this validator sent an initial skip vote. Action: Run trySkipWindow. Send NotarFallbackVote for C. Reason: The block now has sufficient evidence for fallback support. The validator can help make it a usable parent.

a.xlink:title: The block now has sufficient evidence for fallback support. The validator can help make it a usable parent.
V10: SafeToNotar for a\nblock

g.title: V11: Another permitted fallback. When: A further fallback condition is true. The validator has not sent that fallback vote. ItsOver is false. Action: Send the permitted fallback vote after trySkipWindow. Reason: Different fallback certificates can help resolve a failed leader window. The first vote remains fixed.

a.xlink:title: Different fallback certificates can help resolve a failed leader window. The first vote remains fixed.
V11: Another permitted\nfallback

g.title: V12: No new vote in this slot. When: A later event would otherwise cause another vote in this slot. Action: Do not send a new vote in this slot. Reason: A final vote must remain a commitment. Reusing its stake for a conflicting fallback would break the finality argument.

a.xlink:title: A final vote must remain a commitment. Reusing its stake for a conflicting fallback would break the finality argument.
V12: No new vote in this\nslot
a.text: V12: No new vote in this

g.title: Start of the slot. Meaning: The validator starts with no first vote for this slot. Purpose: It must select one initial notar vote or one initial skip vote.
V01: Start the slot. When: The validator starts this slot without a stored first vote. Action: Set the initial vote state to empty. Reason: The validator must select one first vote for this slot.

a.xlink:title: The validator must select one first vote for this slot.
V01: Start the slot
